title: Easy Ribbed Beanie
description: A beginner-friendly wearable made from a ribbed rectangle and simple seam.
expectationText: A wearable project built from simple rows, then seamed into shape so you can finish a real hat without complex shaping.

steps.title: Foundation
steps.instruction: Chain enough stitches to reach from the brim to the crown of the hat.

steps.title: Row 1
steps.instruction: Half double crochet in the third chain from the hook and each chain across.

steps.title: Rows 2 to 36
steps.instruction: Chain 2, turn, and work half double crochet in the back loop only across.

steps.title: Seam the side
steps.instruction: Fold the rectangle and seam the first and last rows together.

steps.title: Close the crown
steps.instruction: Weave yarn around the top edge, pull tight, secure, and weave in ends.
